jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (US, West)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. jobs.description_text: Rejoignez PRECIA MOLEN, le leader innovant du pesage industriel ! Depuis plus de 70 ans, PRECIA MOLEN, entreprise familiale française, conçoit et fabrique des solutions de pesage de haute qualité. Présents à l’échelle nationale et internationale, nous sommes reconnus pour notre expertise et notre engagement en matière de recherche et développement. Nous recherchons notre prochain Ingénieur Electronique (H/F) sur notre agence de Bron (69) ou au siège à Veyras (07). VOTRE QUOTIDIEN : Conception et développement : Rédaction de spécifications techniques et de cahiers des charges.
